==Biography==

== Trivia ==
* Effort's favorite champion to play is {{ci|Rakan}}. <ref>[https://t1.gg/teams/league-of-legends] ''t1.gg''</ref> 
* His favorite colour is blue.
* Is a big fan of the Korean boy band BTS. He is even a member of their fan club, so he has a light stick.
* Looks up to [[Wolf (Lee Jae-wan)|Wolf]].
* Is a very calm and quiet player on stream, in contrast to most of his teammates. 
* Due to his calm and quiet demeanor, it has been often joked about that Effort is actually secretly a robot.
* The usually blank-faced Effort's smile is said to melt the heart of many fans.
* Likes Marvel movies. <ref>[https://youtu.be/mS6LGot35mM?t=150 Random Stuff T1 Players Say during Streams <nowiki>[</nowiki>T1 Stream Highlight<nowiki>]</nowiki>] ''youtube.com''</ref> 
* Promised to dye his hair blue like V from BTS whom he looks up to if T1 won LCK Spring Split in 2020. He fulfilled this promise.<ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7pBpUdVvovs&t=17s Effort dyes his hair, T1 Closer slays, and Teddy duos with Lehends] ''youtube.com''</ref> 
* Watching SKT T1 is the reason Effort dreamed of becoming a pro player, inspired by the SKT Golden Age.<ref>[https://youtu.be/a5J623q0hx8 Effort says he'll dye his hair blue if T1 wins the LCK | Ashley Kang] ''youtube.com''</ref> 
* Started playing League of Legends in 2013. <ref>[https://youtu.be/a5J623q0hx8 Effort says he'll dye his hair blue if T1 wins the LCK | Ashley Kang] ''youtube.com''</ref>
* Mutes all emotes (including his teammates') as he thinks they disturb his concentration. <ref>[https://youtu.be/3BGNPWujnB0?t=433 T1 WIN CAM Moments EP.2]</ref>
